from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A judgment document with its title and cause of action extracted from the text."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title or citation as written")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) as determined from the document content")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document: 行政判决书/行政裁定书/民事判决书/刑事判决书/etc.")
    key_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of key parties mentioned (plaintiffs, defendants, agencies)")
    subject_matter: str | None = Field(description="Brief description of the legal subject matter")
    relevance_to_civil_affairs: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the document appears to involve civil affairs administration based on content")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
